dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave (falcate) trailing edge with a primary spline indentation located approximately one-third of the way down from the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The apex is classified as rounded with a broad pixel radius, lacking a sharp terminal point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin follows a straight-line trajectory at an approximate 45-degree angle relative to the horizontal baseline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The maximum pixel base width is approximately 1.4 times the maximum vertical height of the fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct triangular notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge; multiple light-toned, irregular epidermal markings or scratches are present across the lower lateral surface of the fin.
